name: Fresh Canna Live Resin Brush | Pineapple Express
description: Hop on board for a smooth, tropical ride with Fresh Canna’s 2G Live Resin Concentrate Brush – Pineapple Express, a legendary sativa-hybrid that delivers high-energy euphoria and bold flavor. This easy-to-use brush applicator lets you enhance prerolls, bowls, blunts, or dabs with potent, terpene-rich live resin. Bursting with sweet pineapple, zesty citrus, and earthy pine, Pineapple Express delivers a fast-hitting cerebral boost, promoting focus, creativity, and long-lasting motivation. Whether you're on the go or kicking back, this strain keeps you elevated and refreshed.
